reason: A partial AppSettingsPayload is deliberate (a missing field means leave it alone); mergeSettingsPayload (src/main/settings.ts) validates field by field
Every field is optional; ThemeStore.setOptions (src/main/theme/themeStore.ts) checks each one and ignores a bad field
`current` is a theme spec the renderer holds; the handler re-validates it with validateTheme (src/shared/theme/validate.ts) before use
The bar item is echoed back from what main sent; handlers/plugins.ts reads only `action` and opens an http(s) URL after parsing it
level and scope are checked only as strings (the renderer's callers are typed LogLevel/LogScope); Logger.log (src/main/log/logger.ts) redacts and fixes the written keys
